findings.issue: Wrong grammar identification: どのようにしましょう is NOT the 〜ようにしましょう ('make sure to') pattern; it is the interrogative adverb どのように (どの+よう+に, 'in what way') + volitional しましょう of main-verb する. Only a coincidental string overlap; the token notes analyze it correctly.
findings.current: Here the pattern 〜ようにしましょう appears in a question with the interrogative どの ('which')
findings.suggested: どのように is the interrogative 'in what way / how' (どの+よう+に); しましょう is the polite volitional of する — this is not the 〜ようにする pattern

findings.issue: Same wrong grammar claim as expl_en: identifies どのようにしましょう as the pattern 〜ようにしましょう, but it is the interrogative どのように + volitivo しましょう of する, not the 〜ようにする construction.
findings.current: Aqui o padrão 〜ようにしましょう aparece em pergunta com a interrogativa どの ('qual')
findings.suggested: どのように é o interrogativo 'de que modo / como' (どの+よう+に); しましょう é o volitivo polido de する — não é o padrão 〜ようにする

findings.issue: です glossed as 'is/becomes' — です never means 'becomes' (that is なる). The gloss mirrors pt 'fica', which here is locative ('is located'), not 'become'. Teaches a false meaning of the copula.

en contradicts the record itself: pt ('Tem um cheiro estranho'), lit_en ('There's a strange smell') and both expls read 変な匂いがする as existential perception. 'You smell strange.' shifts the subject to the listener — a marked, context-dependent reading.
Gender agreement error in Portuguese: 'desvantagens' is feminine, so the numeral must be 'Duas', not 'Dois' (the natural pt correctly uses 'duas ou três').
English word 'coverage' left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation; other items in the corpus use 'cobertura'.
findings.current: O foco é coverage de には e do adjetivo 多い.
findings.suggested: O foco é a cobertura de には e do adjetivo 多い.

findings.issue: 'should be glad' misrepresents わけだ: 君が喜ぶわけだ states a natural conclusion ('so that's why you are glad'), not a recommendation/obligation ('should' suggests べきだ/はずだ). The expl next to it correctly says 'it makes sense that you are pleased'.
findings.current: It's reasonable; it's a case where you should be glad.
findings.suggested: It's reasonable; it's (naturally) the case that you are glad.

findings.issue: Garbled disclaimer: the string はず arises only from は + ずっと; のぼり contains no はず, so 'a piece of the words はずっと/のぼり' is confusing/incorrect. Same slip in expl_pt ('pedaço das palavras はずっと/のぼり').
findings.current: the sequence 'はず' only shows up as a piece of the words はずっと/のぼり
findings.suggested: the sequence 'はず' only shows up across は + ずっと (particle + adverb)

findings.issue: Same slip as expl_en: のぼり does not contain the string はず; it only spans は + ずっと.
findings.current: a sequência 'はず' só surge como pedaço das palavras はずっと/のぼり
findings.suggested: a sequência 'はず' só surge atravessando は + ずっと (partícula + advérbio)

findings.issue: Out-of-context sense in gloss: 'de longe' is ずっと's comparative sense ('by far'), which does not apply in 道はずっとのぼりだ ('the whole way'); the en gloss correctly omits it.
findings.current: o tempo todo, continuamente, de longe
